files.purpose: The non-streaming half of the Command Code provider: locates the CLI login (env COMMAND_CODE_API_KEY or ~/.commandcode/auth.json), reads ~/.commandcode/config.json for the CLI's chosen model and per-model reasoning efforts, checks auth with `cmd status`, fetches plan windows and credits from api.commandcode.ai /alpha/billing routes, parses `cmd --list-models` into ModelOption rows, carries hardcoded effort and context-window tables copied from command-code 1.53.1, ships a seed catalog, and embeds plus installs the TypeScript session mod (droppy-code-approvals.ts) that gates tools during headless runs.

feature_notes: apiKey precedence: trimmed COMMAND_CODE_API_KEY wins, else storedLogin().apiKey

authStatus: returns .signedOut immediately when no key; runs `cmd status --no-auto-update` with 25s timeout; regex "Authenticated as (\\S+)" yields .signedIn(name); exit status 3 or text containing "not authenticated"/"not logged in" yields .signedOut; text containing "authentication verified" yields .signedIn(storedLogin userName); otherwise .unknown

planLimits: fetches /alpha/billing/credits and /alpha/billing/subscriptions concurrently with async let; builds windows only for windowLimits.fiveHour (title "5-hour limit") and windowLimits.weekly (title "Weekly") where cap > 0; percent = min(100, used / cap * 100); resetAt > 0 becomes Date(timeIntervalSince1970: resetAt / 1_000); returns nil if no windows and no plan name
Documented dollar caps: Go plan $3 per five hours, Pro plan $16; on-demand credits are never throttled
credits(): total = monthlyCredits + purchasedCredits + freeCredits, currency "USD", toppedUp = purchased, granted = free, monthly = monthly, isUsable = belowThreshold != true

planName: exact lookup on lowercased id first; unknown ids drop a leading "individual" segment and title-case the rest, mapping goat->GOAT, pro->Pro, go->Go, max->Max, ultra->Ultra, teams/team->Teams, and "20x"->"20×" via regex ^(\d+)x$
fetch(): Bearer <key> Authorization header, Accept: application/json, 15s timeout, requires HTTP 200

parseModels skips lines starting with "Available models", "Pass the full id", "cmd ", "Docs:", "Usage"; a line matching ^(\S+)\s{2,}(.+)$ is a model row, otherwise it becomes the section header when it has no space and starts uppercase, or when it is shorter than 24 characters; ids must contain "-" or "/"
" (recommended)" and " (default)" are stripped from the detail and each sets isDefault
Exactly one default survives: the config.json model wins and is moved to index 0, otherwise the first isDefault row keeps the flag
matches(): case-insensitive equality on the whole id, or on the segment after the last "/"
displayName merges trailing all-digit token pairs into one dotted number (claude-fable-5-1 -> Fable 5.1); uppercases gpt, glm, hy3, hy4, v4, v4.1, v2.5; leaves tokens starting with a digit alone

efforts table values: full = [low, medium, high, xhigh, max]; toXHigh = [low, medium, high, xhigh]; toHigh = [low, medium, high]; highMax = [high, max]; lowHighMax = [low, high, max]; sakana/fugu-ultra = [high, xhigh]; the qwen3.8 family = [low, medium, xhigh]; models absent from the table get [] so the effort slider hides

contextWindow examples: claude-sonnet-5 1_000_000, claude-haiku-4-5 200_000, gpt-6-astra 1_050_000, gpt-5.5 400_000, moonshotai/kimi-k2.7-code 256_000, kimi-k2.7-code-highspeed 262_000, z-ai/glm-5.3-flash 1_048_576, qwen/qwen3.8-27b 262_144, xai/grok-4.5 500_000, tencent/hy3-paid 262_144, nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b 1_000_000; unknown ids fall back to the first table entry whose key matches() the id

approvalMod READ_ONLY set (passes through without asking): read_file, read_directory, glob, grep, shell_output, shell_tasks, todo_write, task_create, task_update, task_list, task_get, sleep, web_search, web_fetch, agent, agent_output, activate_skill, taste, get_diagnostics, ask_user_question, plan_review, enter_plan_mode, exit_plan_mode, cron_list, run_command

approvalMod registers MCP tools from DROPPY_CODE_MCP_BRIDGE by importing it and calling bridge.loadMCPTools(), adding each as cmd.addTool with schema name 'mcp__' + server + '__' + name and returning { ok: true, content: [{type:'text', text}] }; failures log via console.error('droppy mcp', error)

approvalMod gate: registers cmd.hooks({beforeToolCall}) only when DROPPY_CODE_APPROVALS is set; sanitizes the tool call id with /[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]/g -> '_'; writes <id>.request.json via a .tmp file plus rename; polls <id>.reply.json every 40 ms; a reply of {decision:'allow'} returns undefined (allow), anything else returns {block: true, additionalContext: answer.reason || 'The user declined this in Droppy Code.'}

approvalMod bail-outs: ctx.signal.aborted returns {block:true, additionalContext:'The turn was stopped.'}; process.ppid === 1 or more than 6 * 60 * 60 * 1000 ms elapsed returns {block:true, additionalContext:'Droppy Code did not answer.'}; both unlink the request file first
installMod() rewrites droppy-code-approvals.ts only when the on-disk bytes differ from the embedded source, so a new build replaces the old mod
unresolved_questions: ProviderCredits.money formatting (symbol, decimal places) is defined elsewhere, so the exact rendered window title text cannot be pinned from this file
AppInfo.name is referenced but not defined here, so the literal Application Support folder name is unknown from this file alone
The fetch path is appended with appendingPathComponent("/alpha/billing/credits"), and whether the leading slash yields a double slash in the final URL depends on Foundation behavior not verified here

files.purpose: The ProviderSession driver for the Command Code CLI in headless print mode: each turn spawns one `cmd -p --output-format json` process with the prompt on stdin, translates its newline-delimited event frames into ProviderEvents (messages, thinking, tools, todos, usage, notices, plan), resumes the CLI session id across turns, maps CLI exit codes to user-facing errors, and runs the file-based approval gate (request/reply JSON in a per-session approvals directory watched with a DispatchSource) that backs Supervised / Auto-accept edits / Auto / Full access.

start() throws ProviderError.notInstalled when configuration.executable is nil, and fails with the stale-conversation message when the resume transcript jsonl is missing
interrupt() sets interruptRequested and SIGTERMs the process; the CLI exits 130 and the run reports .interrupted
Stream frames handled at the top level: type "event" (dispatched to handleEvent) and type "result" (subtype, stopReason, error, sessionId)

Event frames handled: run_start, message_start, text_delta, thinking_start, thinking_delta, thinking_end, message_end, model_request_start, model_request_end, tool_queued, tool_update, tool_completed, tool_errored, tool_hook_blocked, tool_denied, subagent_progress, session_titled, compaction_start, compaction_done, notice, run_error, interrupted, run_end
Explicitly ignored frames: turn_start, turn_end, message_update, model_trace, tool_running, tool_hooks, tool_input_repaired, subagent_start, subagent_stop

model_request_end usage fields: usage.inputTokens + usage.outputTokens; emits .usage with CommandCodeAPI.contextWindow(for: activeModel ?? model), records TokenLedger spend, and emits .tokenSpend(provider: .commandcode) carrying per-request totals rather than a baseline delta
todo_write is intercepted at tool_queued and turned into .todos, never a tool row; its updates, completions and errors are skipped
write_file snapshots the target file at tool_queued so the finished row diffs before against after; finishEdit returns [FileEdit(path:)] with no diff when the contents did not change
todos map status "completed"/"done" to .done, "in_progress"/"active" to .active, everything else to .pending, and read content, then text, then title
Notice levels map "error" to .error, "warning"/"warn" to .warning, everything else to .info
run_end emits .planCompleted only in plan mode and only when result.finalText is non-blank
didClose: pending approvals are resolved, approval files cleared; stop() suppresses further events; interruptRequested or status 130 yields .interrupted
Result subtype "success" with stopReason "max_turns", or subtype "max_turns", both complete the turn and post the turn-cap notice (suppressed when isFinalReport)
isRateLimit matches lowercased "rate limit", "usage exceeded" or "window limit" and emits .usageLimit(resetsAt: nil) before the failure
friendlyError rewrites text containing "not authenticated"/"unauthorized"/"session expired" into the sign-in message and "insufficient credits"/"out of credits" into the top-up message
Exit code 8 counts as a completed turn with the turn-cap notice; exit 0 with no result line also completes

autoApproves by mode: .fullAccess true (and the gate is not even loaded), .supervised false, .autoAcceptEdits only write_file/edit_file, .auto allows edits plus shell_command/powershell/monitor_command whose command is not ShellCommandKind.mayWriteFiles, plus kill_shell, cron_create, cron_delete, task_stop
Approval kind derived from the tool call kind: .command -> .command, .edit -> .fileChange, anything else -> .tool; grantKey collapses .tool/.permissions/.plan to "tool"
resolveApproval treats optionID "allow" and "always" as approve, "always" additionally inserts the grant key; any other option denies
answerQuestion(_:answers:) is an empty no-op: Command Code sessions do not support structured questions
scanApprovals only runs while turnActive, sorts request files by lastPathComponent, deletes each after reading, and skips ids already pending
snapshot() refuses files larger than 1_000_000 bytes or non-UTF-8, returning nil so a write renders as a whole-file addition
